finding.publicSeam: Real OrganizationContextProvider + QueryClient + TeamDirectory + TeamDirectoryRecords + TeamMembersList; real hooks/UI. Only session, server action, fetch, navigation, translation system boundaries stubbed. No implementation hooks mocked.
finding.trigger: GET /api/auth/context returns synthetic 503, then boundary restored. Click visible local Retry. Navigation seam delivers another successful TeamDirectory server result while keeping the same provider and QueryClient.
finding.expected: Second actual canonical context request and admitted employee link
finding.causalExplanation: Directory Retry calls router.refresh only. The actual provider query has retry:false/refetchOnWindowFocus:false and discards context when isError; successful RSC directory props do not call context.refetch. The new scope gate consequently continues hiding records.
finding.classification: Fresh candidate public-seam failure. Retry/gate added by #1739; shared provider not changed. No controlled full historical-provider/browser differential was run; do not claim inherited versus introduced end-to-end behavior beyond these source facts.
